mil6.3.11:1.2: nibbānaṃ na atītaṃ na anāgataṃ na paccuppannaṃ, na uppannaṃ na anuppannaṃ na uppādaniyan-ti.
mil6.3.11:1.3: Idha bhante Nāgasena yo koci sammā paṭipanno nibbānaṃ sacchikaroti so uppannaṃ sacchikaroti udāhu uppādetvā sacchikarotīti.
mil6.3.11:1.4: Yo koci mahārāja sammā paṭipanno nibbānaṃ sacchikaroti so na uppannaṃ sacchikaroti na uppādetvā sacchikaroti. Api ca mahārāja atth' esā nibbānadhātu yaṃ so sammā paṭipanno sacchikarotīti. -
mil6.3.11:2.1: Mā bhante Nāgasena imaṃ pañhaṃ paṭicchannaṃ katvā dīpehi, vivataṃ pākaṭaṃ katvā dīpehi, chandajāto ussāhajāto yaṃ te sikkhitaṃ taṃ sabbaṃ etth' ev' ākirāhi, etthāyaṃ jano sammūḷho vimatijāto saṃsayapakkhanno, bhind' etaṃ antodosasallan-ti.
mil6.3.11:2.2: Atth' esā mahārāja nibbānadhātu santā sukhā paṇītā, taṃ sammā paṭipanno Jinānusatthiyā sankhāre sammasanto paññāya sacchikaroti.
mil6.3.11:2.3: Yathā mahārāja antevāsiko ācariyānusatthiyā vijjaṃ paññāya sacchikaroti,
mil6.3.11:2.4: evam-eva kho mahārāja sammā paṭipanno Jinānusatthiyā paññāya nibbānaṃ sacchikaroti.
mil6.3.11:3.2: anītito nirupaddavato abhayato khemato santato sukhato sātato paṇītato sucito sītalato daṭṭhabbaṃ.
mil6.3.11:4.1: Yathā mahārāja puriso bahukaṭṭhapuñjena jalita-kaṭhitena agginā ḍayhamāno vāyāmena tato muñcitvā niraggikokāsaṃ pavisitvā tattha paramasukhaṃ labheyya,
mil6.3.11:4.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja yo sammā paṭipanno so yoniso manasikārena byapagata-tividhaggisantāpaṃ paramasukhaṃ nibbānaṃ sacchikaroti.
mil6.3.11:4.3: Yathā mahārāja aggi evaṃ tividhaggi daṭṭhabbo,
mil6.3.11:4.4: yathā aggigato puriso evaṃ sammā paṭipanno daṭṭhabbo,
mil6.3.11:5.1: Yathā vā pana mahārāja puriso ahi-kukkura-manussa kuṇapa-sarīravaḷañja-koṭṭhāsarāsigato kuṇapa-jaṭājaṭitantaram-anupaviṭṭho vāyāmena tato muñcitvā nikkuṇapokāsaṃ pavisitvā tattha paramasukhaṃ labheyya,
mil6.3.11:5.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja yo sammā paṭipanno so yoniso manasikārena byapagata-kilesakuṇapaṃ paramasukhaṃ nibbānaṃ sacchikaroti.
mil6.3.11:5.3: Yathā mahārāja kuṇapaṃ evaṃ pañca kāmaguṇā daṭṭhabbā,
mil6.3.11:5.4: yathā kuṇapagato puriso evaṃ sammā paṭipanno daṭṭhabbo,
mil6.3.11:6.1: Yathā vā pana mahārāja puriso bhīto tasito kampito viparīta-vibbhantacitto vāyāmena tato muñcitvā daḷhaṃ thiram acalamabhayaṭṭhānaṃ pavisitvā tattha paramasukhaṃ labheyya,
mil6.3.11:6.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja yo sammā paṭipanno so yoniso manasikārena byapagata-bhayasantāsaṃ paramasukhaṃ nibbānaṃ sacchikaroti.
mil6.3.11:6.3: Yathā mahārāja bhayaṃ evaṃ jāti-jarā-byādhi-maraṇaṃ paṭicca aparāparaṃ pavattabhayaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ,
mil6.3.11:6.4: yathā bhīto puriso evaṃ sammā paṭipanno daṭṭhabbo,
mil6.3.11:7.1: Yathā vā pana mahārāja puriso kiliṭṭha-malina-kalala-kaddamadese patito vāyāmena taṃ kalala-kaddamaṃ apavāhetvā parisuddhavimaladesamupagantvā tattha paramasukhaṃ labheyya,
mil6.3.11:7.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja yo sammā paṭipanno so yoniso manasikārena byapagata-kilesa-malakaddamaṃ paramasukhaṃ nibbānaṃ sacchikaroti.
mil6.3.11:7.3: Yathā mahārāja kalalaṃ evaṃ lābha-sakkāra-siloko daṭṭhabbo,
mil6.3.11:7.4: yathā kalalagato puriso evaṃ sammā paṭipanno daṭṭhabbo,
mil6.3.11:8.1: Tañ-ca pana nibbānaṃ sammā paṭipanno kin-ti sacchikaroti:
mil6.3.11:8.2: Yo so mahārāja sammā paṭipanno so sankhārānaṃ pavattaṃ sammasati,
mil6.3.11:8.3: pavattaṃ sammasamāno tattha jātiṃ passati jaraṃ passati byādhiṃ passati maraṇaṃ passati, na tattha kiñci sukhaṃ sātaṃ passati, ādito pi majjhato pi pariyosānato pi
mil6.3.11:8.4: so tattha na kiñci gayhūpagaṃ passati.
mil6.3.11:8.5: Yathā mahārāja puriso divasasantatte ayoguḷe jalite tatte kaṭhite ādito pi majjhato pi pariyosānato pi na kañci gayhūpagaṃ padesaṃ passati,
mil6.3.11:8.6: evam-eva kho mahārāja yo sankhārānaṃ pavattaṃ sammasati so pavattaṃ sammasamāno tattha jātiṃ passati jaraṃ passati byādhiṃ passati maraṇaṃ passati, na tattha kiñci sukhaṃ sātaṃ passati, ādito pi majjhato pi pariyosānato pi
mil6.3.11:8.7: na kiñci gayhūpagaṃ passati. Tassa gayhūpagaṃ apassantassa citte arati saṇṭhāti, kāyasmiṃ ḍāho okkamati, so attāṇo asaraṇo asaraṇībhūto bhavesu nibbindati.
mil6.3.11:9.1: Yathā mahārāja puriso jalitajālaṃ mahantaṃ aggikkhandhaṃ paviseyya, so tattha attāṇo asaraṇo asaraṇībhūto aggimhi nibbindeyya,
mil6.3.11:9.2: evameva kho mahārāja tassa gayhūpagaṃ apassantassa citte arati saṇṭhāti, kāyasmiṃ ḍāho okkamati, so attāṇo asaraṇo asaraṇībhūto bhavesu nibbindati.
mil6.3.11:10.1: Tassa pavatte bhayadassāvissa evaṃ cittaṃ uppajjati: santattaṃ kho pan' etaṃ pavattaṃ ādittaṃ sampajjalitaṃ bahudukkhaṃ bahupāyāsaṃ; yadi koci labhetha appavattaṃ, etaṃ santaṃ etaṃ paṇītaṃ, yad-idaṃ sabbasankhārasamatho sabbūpadhipaṭinissaggo taṇhakkhayo virāgo nirodho nibbānan-ti.
mil6.3.11:10.2: Iti h' idaṃ tassa appavatte cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati pahaṃsīyati kuhīyati: paṭiladdhaṃ kho me nissaraṇan-ti.
mil6.3.11:11.1: Yathā mahārāja puriso vippanaṭṭho videsapakkhanno nibbāhanamaggaṃ disvā tattha pakkhandati pasīdati pahaṃsīyati kuhīyati: paṭiladdho me nibbāhanamaggo ti,
mil6.3.11:11.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja pavatte bhayadassāvissa appavatte cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati pahaṃsīyati kuhīyati: paṭiladdhaṃ kho me nissaraṇan-ti.
mil6.3.11:12.1: So appavattāya maggaṃ āyūhati gavesati bhāveti bahulīkaroti, tassa tadatthaṃ sati santiṭṭhati, tadatthaṃ viriyaṃ santiṭṭhati, tadatthaṃ pīti santiṭṭhati, tassa taṃ cittaṃ aparāparaṃ manasikaroto pavattaṃ samatikkamitvā appavattaṃ okkamati; appavattam-anuppatto mahārāja sammā paṭipanno nibbānaṃ sacchikarotīti vuccatīti. -
mil6.3.11:12.2: Sādhu bhante Nāgasena, evam-etaṃ, tathā sampaṭicchāmīti.
